housingAlert: Never wire money for a room you have not seen; ask for a live video viewing.
Short-term sublets are common: get a written agreement and check the person subletting is allowed to.
Ask your J-1 sponsor and the previous intern for trusted options.

tasks.title: J-1 sponsor and training plan
tasks.description: Your university does not issue the J-1: a designated BridgeUSA sponsor does. Interns must be enrolled in a foreign degree program or have graduated no more than 12 months before the start date. The host signs the Training/Internship Placement Plan (Form DS-7002). Interns cannot do unskilled or casual labour or positions with more than 20% clerical work.
documentsNeeded: Proof of enrolment or graduation date
Form DS-7002 signed by the host
steps: Find a designated sponsor with your host company
Complete the DS-7002 with the host
Receive the DS-2019 from the sponsor

tasks.title: SEVIS I-901 fee
tasks.description: J visa applicants pay the I-901 SEVIS fee: 220 USD (35 USD for special subsidised J categories). Payment is made at fmjfee.com.
steps: Print the payment confirmation for the interview

tasks.title: DS-160 and visa interview
tasks.description: Complete the online nonimmigrant visa application (DS-160) and attend the interview at the U.S. Embassy. The official State Department pages refused automated access, so the steps and the visa fee are not verified yet.
steps: Pay the visa fee and book the interview
Attend the interview at the U.S. Embassy in Madrid
